title: Starship Action
description: Defines a single, specific action that can be taken by a crew member on a starship.

description.description: Tooltip text explaining the action's rules and outcomes.

station.description: The primary crew station that can perform this action.

skill.description: The skill used for the check, e.g., 'Piloting' or 'Technology'.

difficulty.description: The base difficulty of the check, e.g., 'Easy', 'Hard'.

effects.description: The mechanical results of succeeding on the action's check.

narrative_outcomes.description: List of IDs for valid Advantage/Threat spends when using this action.
